thread:
matt: Quick thought — add a "Quickstart experiment" flow in Console. Defaults: 90/10 split, auto-guard to pause on error rates, presets for common metrics. Would speed up onboarding for small teams. :thinking:

hema: +1 to defaults, but we should make the guard threshold explicit. What metric? latency p95? error rate? model-quality delta?

jules: My vote: default guard = "increase in error rate > 2x baseline OR p95 latency > 2s for 5m". We should also surface the affected routes in the UI.

derek: UI-wise: show a preview of routing rules and the estimated QPS -> GPU allocation impact. People get surprised by cost.

olivia: Could we offer a "safe canary" preset that routes only new users (by cookie) + sample logs to a private bucket for quick eval? Less likely to hit prod spikes.

matt: Nice. Proposal for quickstart JSON we can show in the wizard:
```json
{
  "name": "Quickstart Canary",
  "variants": [
    {"name": "control", "model": "rwd-v1", "weight": 90},
    {"name": "candidate", "model": "rwd-v2-opt", "weight": 10}
  ],
  "guards": {
    "error_rate_multiplier": 2.0,
    "p95_latency_ms": 2000,
    "evaluation_window_minutes": 5
  },
  "routing": {"method": "hash", "key": "user_id"},
  "telemetry": {"sample_rate": 0.1, "destination": "s3://redwood-experiments"}
}
```

jules: Love it. Suggest adding a "quota" block so the console shows monthly token cap to avoid runaway costs.

hema: +1. Also add a tooltip on why hash-by-user_id matters (stickiness for chat sessions).

derek: On API shape: we should prioritize a compact representation for the SDK v2. Eg `split: {control:90, candidate:10}` instead of arrays. We can map in the backend.

matt: Good call. UX question: default sample_rate for telemetry 10% ok? Might be high for large customers.

olivia: Maybe default to 5% but expose a large/low slider. Also add a note: "Logs may contain PII — enable redaction" and link to privacy docs.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview available at https://console.redwood.ai/quickstart-experiments/preview (expires in 2h)

jules: Quick follow-up: add an escape hatch in the UI: "pause experiment" and an automated rollback policy when guard trips. Also show the reason in the timeline.

matt: Agreed — will draft a small RFC for the Quickstart Experiment UX + API mapping. I'll include cost estimates and a short telemetry plan. Tagging @derek for API shape and @hema for threshold wording.

hema: I'll help with wording. Want to keep defaults conservative. :thumbsup:

derek: I'll prototype the SDK mapping and post a short gist tomorrow.

olivia: Thanks all. This should help reduce support tickets for weird canaries.

matt: Thanks — I'll open a PR with the wizard mockups and the default config. Expect it by EOD tomorrow.
